actual: A real P11 custom-evo request persists sector_blacklist at the loop top level, but _prepare_custom_evo_loop_configs calls resolve_and_apply_active_qe_dataset with custom_params before propagating the blacklist. The active resolver therefore materializes the unfiltered stock_universe, omits _qe_sector_blacklist_policy, and the executable prediction universe reports excluded_rows=0. Preserve P10 semantics; fail closed and materialize the requested PIT sector blacklist before task execution; add exact API-path regression coverage.
